response.sql:
WITH patient_averages AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb,
    AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE UA >= 3.9
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_hgb) AS average_of_patient_avg_hgb,
  AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS average_of_patient_avg_aptt_minus_pt
FROM patient_averages;

assumptions.assumption: Patients are included in each across-patient average only when they have at least one qualifying non-NULL value for that measure; SQL AVG ignores NULL values, including when averaging the per-patient values.
